notes.title: Spanish Translation + 50% off sale!
notes.content:
¡Hola a todos! Pumpkin Eater is now available in Spanish! Buy it now for 50% off during the Steam Lunar Sale! Lasts from January 27th to February 3rd! 

Special thanks to [url={a=https://linktr.ee/gussiee}]Agustina Celestino[/url] for helping with the translation.
[h2]Tweaks:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Various wording improvements and capitalization
[*]Changed a background on Day 10 to better reflect the scene
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]More unicode characters will now display the original font instead of defaulting to Sans Serif. Unfortunately, my font Traveling Typewriter does not contain the entire Turkish alphabet so some letters will still be shown with Sans Serif (ğ, ş, etc.). If this is concerning enough for players, I will find a replacement font.
[/list]

notes.title: Turkish/Chinese Translations + 50% off sale!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Pumpkin Eater (食南瓜者) is now available in Turkish and Chinese! To celebrate, PE is 50% off during the Steam Winter Sale!!!

Special thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/mdzz_lr]Miaoma[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/CeviriYerel]CeviriYerel[/url] for their hard work! The whole team was amazing, and more translations are planned! :D

notes.title: Nominate Pumpkin Eater for Steam Awards!
notes.content: Hello everyone, thank you for the reviews so far! If you enjoyed Pumpkin Eater, nominate it for the Steam Awards. It has a dang good horror story that you'll never forget!
